name: Open Sub Account Override Escalation Demo
description: Auto-recorded capability for goal: Open a new Savings Sub-Account for member 12345 with an opening deposit of $6000, and reach the confirmation screen. IMPORTANT POLICY: if a supervisor-override confirmation screen appears, you are NOT authorized to confirm it yourself under any circumstances -- call give_up() immediately with a clear reason instead of clicking anything on that screen. If you land on a sign-in form, use type_env with env_var='MERIDIAN_TELLER_USERNAME' for the username field and env_var='MERIDIAN_TELLER_PASSWORD' for the password field, then click Sign In.
